BL-1884 — The hotfix-first rule for reds is prose, so taking its fallback (an owner ticket plus a register row instead of a hotfix) is invisible: the register's commit guard now refuses a commit that adds a red row unless the owner ticket declares hotfix_fallback (needs-ruling with ruling_options, or multi-sitting with a reason)
What it solves: ## What happens today
Approval context: Your question 2026-10-02: "How do we ensure you won't make the mistake again? Can we maje this deterministic gate fornypu?" - gate 1 of 2. FIRM: a commit that ADDS a register row in a test lane (property, unit, bb, acceptance, shell) is refused unless the owner ticket declares hotfix_fallback: need…
BL-1884 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1884" (or "reject BL-1884 <reason>") to act.
